data_role: Prompts only. Collect fresh Llama-3.3-70B and matching SpecForge EAGLE3 TP8 Verify labels.

dedup_audit.method: NFKC and casefold exact words, >=82% 4-token shingle containment with >=6 shared; Python token check against HumanEval

selection.pilot_rule: Use the 24 frozen pilot questions and interleave the four sources.
selection.main_rule: Exclude pilot IDs and over-budget prompts. In each source and split group, take the first K rows by SHA256(seed + '|' + canonical_question_id). Re-sort per source and interleave the four sources in alphabetical order.
